spells.Erecto: Puts up a tent or another structure so it stands upright.
spells.Furnunculus: Covers the target in boils. Harry hit Goyle with it outside the Potions classroom.
spells.Hover Charm: Makes the target float in mid-air. Dobby used it on Aunt Petunia's pudding.
spells.Obliviate: Wipes specific memories from a person's mind. Hermione used it on her parents.
spells.Permanent Sticking Charm: Fixes an object in place for good. Sirius thought his mother used it to keep her portrait on the wall.
spells.Point Me: Makes the caster's wand act as a compass and turn to face north.
spells.Protego: Casts an invisible barrier that deflects spells and blocks physical objects.
spells.Protego Maxima: A powerful barrier spell against dark magic, stronger and larger when several witches and wizards cast it together.
spells.Riddikulus: Defeats a boggart by forcing it into a shape the caster finds funny. Laughter finishes it off.
spells.Tarantallegra: Makes the target's legs jerk about wildly, as if doing a quickstep.
spells.Piertotum Locomotor: Brings statues and suits of armour to life. McGonagall used it to send the castle's defenders into battle.

potions.Antidote to Common Poisons: Cures everyday poisonings. It contains bezoar, mistletoe berries and unicorn horn.
potions.Antidote to Veritaserum: Undoes the effects of the truth serum.
potions.Baruffio's Brain Elixir: A potion that is supposed to make the drinker cleverer. Fred and George sold it to anxious fifth-years before their exams.
potions.Bruise removal paste: A paste made by a pair of twins to get rid of a purple ring left by a punching telescope.
potions.Burn-Healing Paste: A thick orange ointment that heals burns. Hagrid's dragon-keeping friends would need plenty.
potions.Cure for Boils: The first potion Snape set his first-years. Neville melted Seamus's cauldron making it.
potions.Dreamless Sleep Potion: Gives the drinker a deep, untroubled sleep with no visions. Madam Pomfrey gave it to Harry after the third task.
potions.Elixir of Life: Brewed with the Philosopher's Stone, it keeps the drinker alive for as long as they keep drinking it.
potions.Elixir to Induce Euphoria: Fills the drinker with an inexplicable, irrational happiness. Harry brewed one for Slughorn with a sprig of peppermint.
potions.Love Potion: Makes the drinker infatuated with whoever gave it to them. Romilda Vane slipped one into Chocolate Cauldrons.
potions.Love Potion Antidote: Cures someone of an artificial infatuation. Slughorn gave Ron one on his birthday.
potions.Mandrake Restorative Draught: Restores people who have been Petrified. It needs fully grown roots that scream.
potions.Mrs Scower's All-Purpose Magical Mess Re: A cleaning product Filch reached for when a ghost's message was daubed on his wall.
potions.Sleekeazy's Hair Potion: Tames frizzy, bushy hair. Hermione used it for the Yule Ball.
